spans.s:
f. (-न्दी)
The female of the Sāras or Indian crane.
E.
गो water, नदि to be happy, अच् and ङीष् affs.

m. (-र्दः)
The Sāras or Indian crane.
n. (-र्दं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
गो water, नर्द to sound, affix अच्.

m. (-यः)
A name of the saint PATAÑJALI, the founder of the Yoga philosophy.
E.
गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.

m. (-सः)
1 A large kind of snake, by some considered to be the same with the Boa or

A kind of gem.
E.
गो a cow, and नस a nose, cow-nosed; also गोनास.

m. (-थः)
1 A bull.
2 A herdsman.
E.
गो, and नाथ master.

n. (-न्दं)
Cow's urine.
E.
गो, and निष्यन्द what oozes.
